common_information_rule.signal_time: t is the close time of the final required confirmation bar
common_information_rule.entry_time: next tradable bar open after t; no feature may use data timestamped after t
common_information_rule.bar_data: BID OHLC and tick volume available at or before t; ASK/spread data are required before cost validation
common_information_rule.higher_timeframe_rule: only the most recently completed higher-timeframe bar is available
common_information_rule.rolling_window_rule: all rolling windows end at t or earlier and use no centered statistics
common_information_rule.same_timestamp_cross_market_rule: peer bars must be complete at t; missing peers invalidate the event rather than being forward-filled

common_outcomes.primary: direction-adjusted return from next-bar open to the last close at or before entry+12 real hours, in entry-time ATR14 units
path: MFE through 12 real hours in ATR
MAE through 12 real hours in ATR
common_outcomes.absolute_return_gate: positive matched edge is insufficient when the raw signal return after realistic costs is non-positive

common_matched_control.pool: non-signal bars from the same predeclared target set, instrument, timeframe, and direction
common_matched_control.selection: one nearest control by standardized Euclidean distance, selected without using future returns
common_matched_control.exclusions: control bar cannot fall within 24 real hours of any treated signal for the same instrument
common_matched_control.episode_rule: same instrument, direction, and overlapping 12-hour outcome windows are collapsed to the first event

sample_size_policy.action_below_minimum: REJECT_AS_UNDERPOWERED; do not loosen entry thresholds after counting

candidates.name: Confirmed Balance Break Retest
candidates.lineage: new ID; structural redesign merging PA-101 and PA-102
candidates.hypothesis: A balance break has continuation only after price retests the broken boundary and closes back in the break direction without materially re-entering the balance.
entry_conditions: Let b be a breakout bar among t-3..t-1. The high-low range of bars b-8..b-1 is <=1.25*ATR14(b).
BUY breakout: C[b] >= max(H[b-20:b-1])+0.10*ATR14(b), body/range>=0.55; SELL symmetric.
During b+1..t price touches within 0.20*ATR14(b) of the broken 20-bar boundary, and no close penetrates more than 0.25*ATR14(b) back inside it.
BUY confirmation at t: C[t] is >= boundary+0.05*ATR14(t) and close-location>=0.65; SELL symmetric.
Enter in the confirmed direction at the next bar open.
entry_time_information: break and retest bars through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on 8-bar range/ATR quartile
weaknesses: confirmation delays entry
gap-like commodity moves may never retest
overlaps conceptually with LV-202

candidates.name: Failed 20-Bar Break Reversal
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis; not a post-hoc sign flip of PA-101/PA-105
candidates.hypothesis: A decisive new 20-bar extreme that is reclaimed within two bars traps late breakout participation and mean-reverts.
entry_conditions: Break bar b closes >=0.15*ATR14(b) beyond the prior 20-bar high, or <=-0.15*ATR below the prior low, with close-location>=0.75 in the break direction.
By t<=b+2, price closes at least 0.10*ATR14(t) back inside the pre-break 20-bar boundary.
The reclaim bar body/range>=0.40 and close-location>=0.60 in the reversal direction.
Enter opposite the failed break at the next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed OHLC through reclaim bar t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on breakout-distance quartile; controls are unreclaimed breakouts
weaknesses: reclaim may be a normal retest before continuation
large spread around news can mimic a failure

candidates.name: Higher-Timeframe Trend Pullback Re-acceleration
candidates.lineage: new ID; structural redesign of PA-103
candidates.hypothesis: A lower-timeframe pullback resumes only when a completed higher timeframe shows a persistent trend and the lower timeframe prints structural re-acceleration.
entry_conditions: Regime map is fixed: M15 uses completed H4; H1 and H4 use completed D1.
BUY regime: EMA20>EMA60 and EMA20(t)-EMA20(t-5)>=0.25*ATR14 on the regime timeframe; SELL symmetric.
On the signal timeframe, the last 2..6 bars retrace 0.50..1.75*ATR14 against the regime and touch EMA20, but no bar closes beyond EMA50 against the regime.
BUY confirmation at t closes above max(H[t-2:t-1]) with body/range>=0.50; SELL symmetric.
Enter with the higher-timeframe regime at the next bar open.
entry_time_information: signal-timeframe OHLC and EMA through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on higher-timeframe EMA20-EMA60 gap quartile and pullback-depth quartile
weaknesses: EMA trend is delayed
H4 signals depend on daily close convention
cross-timeframe synchronization must be audited

candidates.name: European Session Range False-Break
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis; PA-105 continuation remains retired
candidates.hypothesis: A false break of a fixed pre-European range that rapidly returns inside the range is a rejection event, distinct from an ordinary session breakout.
entry_conditions: Define the range once per UTC day from bars with open times 00:00<=time<06:00; eligible break bars open 06:00<=time<10:00.
The pre-session range must be 0.75..2.50*the ATR14 measured at 06:00.
Break bar b trades and closes >=0.15*ATR beyond the range high, or <=-0.15*ATR below the range low.
By t<=b+2, a completed bar closes >=0.10*ATR back inside the range with close-location>=0.65 in the reversal direction.
Only the first false break per UTC day and side is eligible; enter opposite the break next bar open.
candidates.matched_control: same instrument, timeframe, year, calendar month, direction, and pre-session-range/ATR quartile; unreclaimed breaks are excluded from controls
weaknesses: UTC does not follow daylight-saving changes
energy instruments are intentionally excluded
news releases can dominate session effects

candidates.name: Long-Horizon Trend with Intraday Pullback
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis grounded in long-horizon time-series momentum
candidates.hypothesis: D1 trends measured over weeks, rather than hours, persist and can be entered after a bounded H1/H4 countertrend pullback.
entry_conditions: Using the last completed D1 bar, signed 20-day and 60-day close returns have the same sign.
abs(60-day close return)/D1_ATR20 >=2.50 and the 60-day direction defines BUY or SELL.
On H1/H4, the prior 2..6 bars retrace 0.50..1.50*signal-timeframe ATR14 against the D1 direction.
At t, price closes beyond the prior 3-bar extreme in the D1 direction with body/range>=0.50.
Enter next bar open in the D1 direction.
entry_time_information: last completed D1 OHLC through prior day
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on D1 60-day return/ATR decile; controls lack the bounded pullback-and-resumption pattern
weaknesses: slow trend reversals
roll/financing effects are absent from spot OHLC
H1 and H4 events can overlap

candidates.name: Seasonally Adjusted Participation Shock
candidates.lineage: new ID; measurement redesign of VV-101
candidates.hypothesis: A directional expansion continues only when participation is exceptional relative to the same instrument and UTC bar slot, spread is normal, and the next bar confirms rather than fully retraces it.
entry_conditions: SeasonalVolumeRatio[t]=tick_volume[t]/median of the previous 40 trading-day observations with the same instrument, timeframe, and UTC bar-start slot.
Shock bar b has SeasonalVolumeRatio>=1.75, range>=1.50*ATR14, body/range>=0.60, and close-location>=0.75 in its direction.
Observed spread at b is <=the trailing 252-slot 80th percentile; missing spread invalidates the event.
Confirmation bar t=b+1 closes in the shock direction beyond the shock midpoint and does not close beyond the opposite 50% of the shock range.
Enter in the shock direction next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed tick volume and OHLC through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on raw tick-volume decile; treatment is distinguished by seasonal residual and confirmation
weaknesses: tick volume is not signed order flow
40-day same-slot warm-up is large
historical spread may be unavailable in discovery source

candidates.name: Squeeze Release Retest
candidates.lineage: new ID; confirmation redesign of VV-102
candidates.hypothesis: A low-volatility release persists only when the expansion boundary survives a prompt retest.
entry_conditions: Before break b, median true range of b-12..b-1 is <=the 20th percentile of the 240 true ranges ending at b-13.
Break bar b closes beyond the 12-bar high/low by >=0.10*ATR14 with range>=1.25*ATR14 and body/range>=0.55.
Within b+1..b+3 price touches within 0.20*ATR of the broken boundary, with no close >0.20*ATR back inside.
Final confirmation t closes back beyond the boundary with close-location>=0.65 in the break direction; enter next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed OHLC and true range through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on pre-break 12-bar median-TR percentile; controls are releases without a successful retest
weaknesses: overlap with PS-201
percentiles can shift across market regimes
confirmation may erase reward-to-risk

candidates.name: Confirmed Climactic Absorption
candidates.lineage: new ID; confirmation redesign of VV-103
candidates.hypothesis: An extreme, high-participation terminal wick reverses only when the following bar recovers the extreme bar midpoint without making a meaningful new extreme.
entry_conditions: Prior three-bar move into b is >=1.00*ATR14 in the exhausted direction.
Bar b range>=2.50*ATR14, SeasonalVolumeRatio>=1.50, and terminal wick/range>=0.40 on the exhausted side.
Confirmation t=b+1 does not extend the exhausted extreme by more than 0.10*ATR14 and closes through b midpoint in the reversal direction.
Confirmation body/range>=0.40; enter in the reversal direction next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed OHLC and seasonally normalized tick volume through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on b range/ATR and SeasonalVolumeRatio deciles; controls are climax bars lacking midpoint recovery
weaknesses: rare on H4
extreme bars have high slippage
one-bar confirmation may still be too short

candidates.name: Isolated Illiquidity Dislocation
candidates.lineage: independent new compound hypothesis; VV-104 itself remains retired
candidates.hypothesis: A large move caused by unusually high price impact, not confirmed by related markets and then reclaimed, is a temporary dislocation rather than informative price discovery.
entry_conditions: ImpactScore[t]=(range[t]/ATR14[t])/max(SeasonalVolumeRatio[t],0.10) is >=its trailing 240-bar 90th percentile and range[t]>=1.50*ATR14.
SeasonalVolumeRatio[t]<=0.80 while observed spread<=its trailing same-slot 80th percentile; missing spread invalidates the event.
Fixed peers show median signed same-direction return <=0.30 ATR over the signal bar. FX peers are derived from leave-one-pair-out currency scores; metals and energy use the other family instrument.
Within the next two completed bars, price closes through the signal-bar midpoint in the reversal direction with close-location>=0.60.
Enter opposite the dislocation at the next bar open.
entry_time_information: OHLC, tick volume, and spread through final reclaim bar
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on ImpactScore decile; controls have peer confirmation or lack a reclaim
weaknesses: historical spread is mandatory
peer mapping for FX is model-dependent
resembles VV-104 unless all three added mechanisms are enforced

candidates.name: Volatility-Managed Trend Resumption
candidates.lineage: new ID; VV-105 directional volatility thesis is retired
candidates.hypothesis: Volatility is more useful for sizing an independently defined long-horizon trend entry than for predicting direction from a volatility jump.
entry_conditions: D1 20-day and 60-day returns share a sign and abs(60-day return)/D1_ATR20>=2.50.
H4 bars t-3..t-1 retrace 0.50..1.50*H4_ATR14 against the D1 direction; t closes beyond their extreme in the D1 direction.
Annualized H4 realized volatility RV20 is computed only through t and must be between its trailing 252-bar 10th and 95th percentiles.
Enter next H4 open. Position multiplier=min(1.50,max(0.25,target_vol/RV20)); target_vol is fixed at preregistration and not selected by return.
entry_time_information: RV20 and trailing volatility distribution through t
candidates.matched_control: the exact same entry timestamps and directions at unit notional; compare return volatility, drawdown, expected shortfall, and cost-adjusted return
weaknesses: not a pure event-edge hypothesis
volatility scaling can increase turnover
target-vol choice must be fixed without maximizing return

candidates.name: Cross-Sectional FX Momentum Rank
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis informed by currency momentum research
candidates.hypothesis: The relative ranking of currency strength over weeks is more informative than same-direction USD or JPY breadth over hours.
entry_conditions: At each completed D1 close, estimate AUD/EUR/GBP/JPY/USD strength scores by least squares from all eight oriented pair log returns over 20 and 60 D1 bars, with currency scores constrained to sum to zero.
For each tradable pair, the base-minus-quote score gap must have the same sign at 20 and 60 days and rank in the top absolute quartile among the eight pairs.
The pair was in the top absolute quartile on at least 3 of the previous 5 completed D1 dates.
On H4, a 2..6-bar pullback of 0.50..1.50 ATR is followed by a close beyond the prior 3-bar extreme in the score-gap direction; enter next H4 open.
If multiple pairs qualify at the same t, trade only the pair with the largest absolute 60-day score gap.
entry_time_information: completed D1 prices for all eight FX pairs
no future ranking or pair substitution
candidates.matched_control: same date and H4 trigger among pairs in the middle two score-gap quartiles, matched on absolute 60-day return and volatility
weaknesses: small eight-pair cross-section
currency scores depend on network coverage
portfolio concentration may repeatedly select JPY pairs

candidates.name: Currency-Basket Residual Reversion
candidates.lineage: independent new relative-value hypothesis; MR-101/MR-102 continuation remain retired
candidates.hypothesis: A single FX pair that moves far beyond the move implied by its two currencies and the remaining pair network tends to close part of the residual gap.
entry_conditions: For each target pair and bar t, estimate base and quote currency 12-bar returns from the other seven pairs only; the target pair is excluded from its own basket fit.
Residual=target 12-bar log return minus the leave-one-pair-out implied return. Standardize using the previous 240 target-timeframe residuals.
At bar b, abs(residual_z)>=2.00 while the median absolute standardized return of the seven peer pairs is <=1.00.
By t<=b+2, residual z moves toward zero by >=0.25 and the target closes in the reversion direction; enter next bar open toward zero.
entry_time_information: same-timestamp completed bars for all eight FX pairs
leave-one-out rolling residual history ending before b
candidates.matched_control: same pair, timeframe, year, UTC bucket, direction, and residual-z band 1.00..1.50; controls are not extreme
weaknesses: synchronous data gaps invalidate events
currency network may be underidentified during missing bars
residual can reflect genuine pair-specific news

candidates.name: Gold-Silver Dynamic Hedge Residual
candidates.lineage: independent pair-residual hypothesis replacing MR-103 co-momentum
candidates.hypothesis: A temporary deviation in the dynamically hedged gold-silver residual mean-reverts when the prior formation window shows stable positive comovement and finite half-life.
entry_conditions: Using the last 120 completed D1 observations, regress log(XAU) on log(XAG) with intercept; require beta>0 and R-squared>=0.60.
Fit AR(1) to lagged residuals using only the same formation window; require 0.10<rho<0.95 and implied half-life between 2 and 30 D1 bars.
Standardize the current completed H4 residual using the prior 120 D1 residual mean and standard deviation; at b abs(z)>=2.00.
At t=b+1, z moves toward zero by >=0.25 without exceeding abs(z)=3.50; enter a beta-hedged two-leg position toward zero next H4 open.
entry_time_information: completed synchronous H4 prices through t
rolling beta, residual, rho, and z known at t
candidates.matched_control: same pair formation state and z direction with 1.00<=abs(z)<=1.50, matched on beta, R-squared, half-life, and volatility
weaknesses: cointegration can break
two-leg costs and margin are material
spot/CFD closing times must be synchronized

candidates.name: Brent-WTI Dynamic Hedge Residual
candidates.lineage: new ID; structural redesign of MR-104
candidates.hypothesis: A dynamically hedged Brent-WTI residual with stable recent mean reversion is superior to a raw 24-hour performance-gap reversal.
entry_conditions: Using the last 120 completed D1 observations, regress log(Brent) on log(WTI) with intercept; require beta>0 and R-squared>=0.70.
Fit AR(1) to formation residuals; require 0.10<rho<0.95 and implied half-life between 2 and 30 D1 bars.
At completed H4 bar b, abs(residual_z)>=2.00 using only the lagged formation mean and standard deviation.
At t=b+1, z moves toward zero by >=0.25 and remains abs(z)<3.50; enter beta-hedged two-leg reversion next H4 open.
entry_time_information: completed D1 Brent and WTI formation data
contract/CFD roll metadata available at t
candidates.matched_control: same beta/R-squared/half-life state and z direction with 1.00<=abs(z)<=1.50, excluding roll-distorted bars
weaknesses: roll and CFD financing can dominate
structural oil-market shocks break the spread
two-leg execution requires synchronized quotes

candidates.name: FX Carry-Momentum Agreement
candidates.hypothesis: A tradable FX carry differential is less vulnerable when medium-horizon spot momentum agrees and volatility is not in its extreme tail.
entry_conditions: At the previous D1 close, obtain a reproducible tradable annualized carry estimate from historical 1-month forward points or broker financing for both long and short directions; policy rates alone are forbidden.
Eligible direction has expected carry>=+2.00% annualized and D1 60-day spot return in the same direction with abs(return)/D1_ATR20>=2.00.
D1 RV20 percentile over the prior 252 D1 bars is <=80.
On H4, a 2..6-bar pullback of 0.50..1.50 ATR is followed by a close beyond the prior 3-bar extreme in the carry/momentum direction; enter next H4 open.
If financing history is not point-in-time reproducible, the candidate is rejected for data insufficiency before testing.
entry_time_information: point-in-time historical forward or financing data available by prior D1 close
candidates.matched_control: same pair, direction, year, volatility decile, and momentum decile with carry between -0.50% and +0.50% annualized
weaknesses: required historical forward/financing series is not yet available
carry crashes during deleveraging
financing terms differ from institutional forwards
